thread:
zoe: Hey! First day. On M1 MacBook (Ventura) using company WireGuard split-tunnel. `brew install node` hangs fetching bottles from our internal cache (mirror.internal.redwood). Public downloads (homebrew core) are fine. `curl -v` to mirror IP times out during TLS handshake. Any quick tips?

infra-jen: welcome!! Two quick things to check: DNS resolution (are you hitting internal IP?) and whether the WireGuard profile pushed the internal CIDR and DNS. Run `scutil --dns` and `dig @10.10.0.2 mirror.internal.redwood +short`. Also try `curl --resolve mirror.internal.redwood:443:10.10.5.4 https://mirror.internal.redwood/ -v` to bypass DNS.

zoe: dig to 10.10.0.2 returns 10.10.5.4. `curl --resolve` times out. `netstat -rn` shows default via en0, utun1 has the 10/8 route. Not sure which interface is used.

sam: macOS sometimes prefers en0 for certain sockets; Homebrew launches processes that might not inherit the system resolver correctly. Quick unblock: use the bastion SOCKS tunnel and set `HOMEBREW_FORCE_BREWED_CURL=1` with `ALL_PROXY=socks5h://localhost:1080` or configure brew to use `curl` with proxy. Example: `ssh -D 1080 -p 2200 zoe@bastion.internal` then `export ALL_PROXY=socks5h://localhost:1080` and retry.

zoe: started ssh -D and set ALL_PROXY, brew still stalls (seems brew spawns privileged child?).

infra-jen: try `sudo -E env ALL_PROXY=$ALL_PROXY HOMEBREW_FORCE_BREWED_CURL=1 brew install node` so env gets preserved for the elevated process. Also check Docker/Virtualization helpers; sometimes brew uses curl from /usr/bin which ignores env proxies. Installing brewed curl first helps (`brew install curl` then link).

zoe: `sudo -E ...` worked! brew downloads bottles via bastion SOCKS and install proceeds. Will add note to my onboarding doc.

deploy-bot: INF-1715 created: "homebrew + split-tunnel + bastion proxy note for onboarding" assigned to eng-infra.

bastion-bot: Reminder: bastion SOCKS available `ssh -D 1080 zoe@bastion.internal -p 2200`.

zoe: thanks everyone — adding a checklist item: "If brew hangs on internal mirror, use bastion SOCKS + sudo -E preserve env or install brewed curl" :tada:
